english.title: Master of ship / commander of aircraft depart without valid clearance
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the

(A)_[master of a ship,]_
(B)_[commander of an aircraft]_

namely **(..SPECIFY THE SHIP / AIRCRAFT..), required to be cleared under section 64 of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979 and which departed from a

(C)_[port]_
(D)_[customs and excise airport]_

at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION OF THE PORT / AIRPORT..) without a valid clearance
english.legislation: Contrary to section 64(6) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
